matthew.10.p1.b1.text: And calling His twelve disciples to Him,

matthew.10.p1.b2.text: Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.

matthew.10.p2.b1.text: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew;

matthew.10.p2.b2.text: James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;

matthew.10.p2.b4.text: Thomas and Matthew the tax collector;

matthew.10.p2.b5.text: James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

matthew.10.p2.b6.text: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.

matthew.10.p3.b1.text: Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.

matthew.10.p3.b2.text: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

matthew.10.p3.b3.text: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’ Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons.

matthew.10.p3.b4.text: Freely you have received; freely give.

matthew.10.p4.b1.text: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.

matthew.10.p4.b2.text: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff;

matthew.10.p4.b3.text: for the worker is worthy of his provisions.

matthew.10.p5.b1.text: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.

matthew.10.p5.b2.text: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it;

matthew.10.p5.b3.text: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet

matthew.10.p5.b4.text: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.

matthew.10.p6.b1.text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves;

matthew.10.p6.b2.text: therefore be as shrewd as snakes

matthew.10.p7.b1.text: But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.

matthew.10.p7.b2.text: In that hour you will be given what to say.

matthew.10.p7.b3.text: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

matthew.10.p8.b1.text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child;

matthew.10.p8.b2.text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name,

matthew.10.p8.b3.text: but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

matthew.10.p8.b4.text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next.

matthew.10.p9.b1.text: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

matthew.10.p9.b2.text: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!

matthew.10.p9.b3.text: So do not be afraid of them.

matthew.10.p9.b4.text: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.

matthew.10.p10.b1.text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

matthew.10.p10.b2.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

matthew.10.p10.b3.text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

matthew.10.p10.b4.text: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

matthew.10.p11.b1.text: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.

matthew.10.p11.b2.text: I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.

matthew.10.p11.b3.text: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

matthew.10.p11.b4.text: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’

matthew.10.p12.b1.text: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me;

matthew.10.p12.b2.text: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

matthew.10.p12.b3.text: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

matthew.10.p13.b1.text: He who receives you receives Me,

matthew.10.p13.b2.text: and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.

matthew.10.p13.b3.text: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward,

matthew.10.p13.b4.text: and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

matthew.10.p14.b1.text: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple,

matthew.10.p14.b2.text: truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
